title: Security re-authentication
intro: Protected actions (voids, settings saves, restricted tabs, print overrides, and more) can require a manager to re-authenticate with PIN, password, or QR — even if you are already signed in.

sections.title: When re-auth appears
steps: You attempt an action your role does not auto-allow, or the action always requires approval.
A modal opens with a short description of what is being approved.
Session security settings (idle lock) are separate — that locks the terminal; this modal approves one action.
sections.caption: Session security settings (related but separate from action re-auth).

sections.title: Approval modal
steps: Read the action description in the modal title.
Choose PIN, password, or QR when multiple methods are available.
Complete authentication to continue, or cancel to abort the action.
sections.caption: Manager approval (security) modal.

sections.title: Auth method buttons
sections.intro: Venues can allow more than one manager auth method.
steps: Tap PIN for the numeric pad.
Tap Password for username/password style entry when enabled.
Tap QR when a scanned manager badge is supported.
sections.caption: PIN / password / QR method selector.

sections.title: PIN entry
steps: Enter the approving manager's 4-digit PIN on the pad.
Dots fill as digits are entered; validation runs when four digits are complete.
Invalid PIN shows an error — clear and try again, or cancel.
sections.caption: Security PIN pad.
